webster.text: Almighty power; unlimited or infinite power; a word in strictness applicable only to God.

example.quote: But in order to comprehend this subject fully, and to draw from it all the instruction which it offers, the question must be asked, under what circumstances, and by what means, this Executive omnipotence has been brought about?
example.cite: James Madison, Political Reflections, Aurora General Advertiser, Feb. 23, 1799
